stem: How does Millie’s behavior during the volleyball game influence the development of the plot?

options.label: A
options.text: It convinces Millie’s mother that Millie should avoid playing sports.

options.label: B
options.text: It leads the other players on the team to ignore Millie after the game.

options.label: C
options.text: It inspires Emily to want to teach Millie how to be a better player.

options.label: D
options.text: It causes Emily to notice Millie and recognize her discomfort.
